import re
path = "src/test/java/com/sm/instagram/platform/unit/service/CurrencyServiceUnitTest.java"
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

pattern = re.compile(r'new Currency\(([^()]*)\)')

def repl(m):
    args = m.group(1)
    # only touch 5-arg all-args-constructor calls, not no-arg `new Currency()`
    if args.strip() == "":
        return m.group(0)
    return f'new Currency({args}, 0)'

new_content, n = pattern.subn(repl, content)
print("replacements:", n)
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(new_content)
EOF
